theme: Light theme only, RTL (Right-to-Left) Arabic layout.

typography.instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the document dir='rtl' attribute is set on the HTML tag. Import Tajawal from Google Fonts in index.html or global CSS. Use logical CSS properties in Tailwind (e.g., ms-, me-, ps-, pe-, text-start, text-end) to guarantee RTL compatibility natively without writing negative margins. Avoid Inter or generic fonts; Tajawal adds the required professional Arabic touch.

colors.instructions_to_main_agent: User explicitly requested to NOT make the entire UI cyan. The primary color #04CDF9 should ONLY be used for primary buttons, active navigation states, selected checkboxes/radios, and small visual accents (like a thin border-top on a card). Use background.app for page background and background.card for containers.

layouts.sidebar: Fixed on the right side (RTL). Desktop: w-64, bg-white, border-l border-gray-200. Mobile: hidden behind a hamburger menu (Sheet component from shadcn). Includes the IQRA logo at the top.
layouts.header: Sticky at the top, h-16, bg-white, border-b border-gray-200, flex items-center justify-between px-4 sm:px-6. Contains user profile dropdown and mobile menu toggle.
layouts.page_container: Flex-1 flex flex-col overflow-hidden. Content wrapper: p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-8 max-w-7xl mx-auto w-full space-y-6.
layouts.dashboard_grid: Grid of 4 Stat Cards: grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6.
layouts.instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the sidebar uses border-l (or border-e in RTL) to separate from main content. Add padding to avoid overlapping. Provide plenty of whitespace inside cards (p-6). Use subtle roundness (rounded-xl) and small shadows (shadow-sm).

cards.style: bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-xl shadow-sm p-6

buttons.primary: bg-[#04CDF9] text-white hover:bg-[#03A9D1] rounded-lg px-4 py-2 font-medium transition-colors focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#04CDF9] focus:ring-offset-2
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-gray-700 border border-gray-300 hover:bg-gray-50 rounded-lg px-4 py-2 font-medium transition-colors

inputs.style: bg-white border border-gray-300 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-gray-900 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#04CDF9] focus:border-transparent transition-all

tables.header: text-xs text-gray-700 uppercase bg-gray-50 border-b border-gray-200

tabs_or_accordions.usage: Use for the multi-section student registration form to prevent cognitive overload. Vertical tabs are preferred for desktop, accordion for mobile.

components.instructions_to_main_agent: Use Shadcn UI for inputs, buttons, tables, and dialogs. Strip any dark mode classes. Use logical classes for paddings and margins to support RTL properly.

specific_views.login: Two-column layout on desktop: Left (or right in RTL) column with a beautiful geometric Islamic pattern image or school building, and a white card centered in the other column. Minimal form, IQRA logo at the top.
specific_views.student_registration_form: Complex form. Group into logical sections: 1. Student Info, 2. Siblings (Dynamic Table), 3. Father, 4. Mother, 5. General Info, 6. Previous Education (Dynamic Table), 7. Islamic Legal Education, 8. Best Achievement, 9. Other Info/Notes, 10. Signing section. Since it's huge, consider a stepper or stacked card layout with clear anchor links or vertical tabs.

print_a4_view.css: @media print { body { background: white; } .no-print { display: none !important; } .print-only { display: block !important; } .page-break { page-break-before: always; } @page { size: A4; margin: 20mm; } }
print_a4_view.layout: Must look like an official A4 document. Remove all shadows and rounded corners for print. Use standard black/gray text. Include the IQRA logo in the header and formal signature lines at the bottom.

visual_enhancers.borders: Use subtle 1px borders (border-gray-200) instead of heavy shadows to define areas.
visual_enhancers.whitespace: Generous spacing. Use gap-6 or gap-8 between major sections. Cards should have p-6 minimum.
visual_enhancers.icons: Use lucide-react. They must visually balance the Arabic typography. Remember to flip directional icons (like chevrons) when in RTL.
visual_enhancers.interactions: Hover states on all buttons and table rows. Focus rings on all inputs.

login_background.description: Intricate blue and yellow geometric tile mosaic on a domed ceiling. Use as a side cover image for the login page.

student_placeholder.description: A young schoolboy in uniform. Use as avatar placeholder in student detail views.

accessibility_and_testing.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute. Format: kebab-case, role-based. e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='add-sibling-btn'.
accessibility_and_testing.accessibility: Ensure contrast ratios for the #04CDF9 primary color. For white text on #04CDF9, ensure the font is bold/large enough, or slightly darken the cyan for hover states to improve contrast. Support standard keyboard navigation.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You are building a production-ready, minimal but polished app in Arabic ONLY.

RTL configuration is CRITICAL. You must set dir='rtl' on the HTML/root element and use Tailwind's logical properties (start/end) instead of left/right where applicable. Shadcn components might need minor manual RTL tweaking (like margin-left vs margin-right on icons).
Use 'Tajawal' font for a professional look. Import it via Google Fonts.
Do NOT overuse the primary cyan color. Keep the app white/slate, using cyan only for primary actions.
Ensure the Print view strictly follows A4 dimensions and hides the UI elements (sidebar, buttons).
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for overlays, dropdowns, or modals. Use bg-white with shadow-lg.
Use purely .js files (with React + Tailwind), no TypeScript.
Add data-testid to every actionable element.
